page: Microsoft Azure D128ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the Dadsv7 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It includes 7559 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the D128ads_v7 demonstrates top-tier performance, placing in the top 10% for both single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests. Its memory subsystem achieves top-tier read and write bandwidths, with cached small-block reads reaching 12266.71 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 389.75 GB/sec. The processor's support for advanced vector extensions (AVX, AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16) and cryptography instructions (AES, VAES, SHA_NI) drives high-throughput capabilities. This is reflected in its top-tier performance in gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and Passmark CPU tests.

The server is highly optimized for resource-dense workloads that require substantial local storage and high-throughput processing without dedicated GPU acceleration. It excels in database operations, as evidenced by its top-tier Passmark database and Redis SET benchmark results, which exceed 177 million operations per second. Additionally, the instance shows strong to top-tier performance in CPU-based LLM inference tasks. Given its high core density and massive 7559 GB local storage capacity, the D128ads_v7 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for large-scale web serving, database hosting, and parallelized data processing workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure D128ads_v7 is a high-capacity, general-purpose virtual machine from the Dadsv7 family, powered by a dedicated 128-vCPU AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with 64 physical cores, it features 512.0 GB of RAM and 7559 GB of local storage. The server delivers top-tier performance across CPU, memory bandwidth, and cryptographic benchmarks, supported by advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and VAES. Lacking a GPU, it relies on its massive core count and memory architecture to achieve top-tier results in Redis operations, database processing, and CPU-based LLM inference. This hardware profile makes the D128ads_v7 highly cost-efficient for resource-dense workloads, including large-scale database hosting, high-throughput web serving, and parallel data processing.
